narrative: On the almanack. The penny almanac open on the desk beside the candle. One printed day. His mark beside it is short. No hour is written by the hand. On the almanack. The next leaf is the last of the year. The same short mark. He does not add a title.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the two lines and left them.

entities.name: the penny almanac
entities.context: Shown on almanac in Read Tuesday and Wednesday in the almanac
